pythonFunction.name: set_escalation_trigger
pythonFunction.description: Sets the escalation trigger state variable to signal that the current conversation should be transferred to a live human agent. Call this when: (1) the customer explicitly requests to speak to a person or human agent, (2) the issue cannot be resolved by the agent after retries, or (3) the request is out of scope. Do NOT call escalate_to_human directly — this tool signals intent; the before_model_callback will execute the transfer deterministically with correct context. After calling this tool, do not say anything further.
